runtimeDelta.changes: Only Worker identity and regional directory wording. No copied previous-region customer collections or ownership proof.

safetyChecks.rejected403SameFingerprint: Blocks next POST, including when the 403 is older than an unrelated receipt.
safetyChecks.received200and202SameFingerprint: Reuses accepted receipt; one total POST across two invocations.
safetyChecks.startedOrUnknown: Blocks re-POST; additionally verified HTTP200 followed by failed receipt persistence leaves started and blocks re-POST.
safetyChecks.journalFailure: No POST if started record cannot be persisted.
safetyChecks.sourceIdentity: Workflow checks exact source branch HEAD before checkout/publication/finalization and full 40-character source SHA; control checkout is exact github.sha.
safetyChecks.artifactDigest: Full release manifest SHA-256, exact identity and per-file inventory checked; independent digest-tamper test rejected.
safetyChecks.credentials: Node22 source test/build job has no provider secrets; checkout persists no credentials; provider-scoped steps consume static artifact rather than source code.
safetyChecks.providerScopes: Only fixed account GETs and exact Worker hostname PUT with all three overrides false; other accounts, DNS, security endpoints, methods, zones, origins and extra flags rejected.
safetyChecks.bindingReuse: Already exact-bound attach path is GET-only; initial publish blocks existing target; readback requires actual exact binding.
safetyChecks.otherDomainsFlags: Prepared runtime has two scoped changes; no existing domains, flags, registries or helper source modified. Final remote diff still pending.

requiredFinalEvidence: Final reviewed real source exact SHA and complete remote source readback
Exact deployed control SHA and remote diff allowlist, including unchanged shared helpers, other domain/registry/feature flags
